text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein receives more congratulations from Arab leaders on Iraq's National Day.
- A foreign ministry spokesman rejects Iranian allegations that Iraq is still holding Iranian prisoners of war.
- An editorial and articles marking the 29th anniversary of July 17, 1968 revolution.
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and IRAQ)
